page.notes: The lower part of the page is cut off in this scan, so the index continues beyond the transcribed lines. Some numerals and the underlining of "Quotuplex" and "Respectivus" are uncertain in the reproduction; underlining is not marked. The large initial S at the start of the first entry is a decorative letter; the entry reads "Scholæ instrumenta Philosophiæ." Some page numbers in the right column are set in the old long-s and italic forms and are copied as read.
